# OrderTracker

Live order status: a big ETA, one live line ("Ravi is 2.1 km away") and a rail that fills to the current step.

`IK.OrderTracker` · After purchase

## Use

```jsx
<IK.OrderTracker />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="IK.OrderTracker"></x-import>
```

## Props (OrderTrackerProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | `TrackStep[]` |  |
| `current` | `number` | Index of the step the order is at. |
| `eta` | `string` | "6:40 pm". Shown big while in transit. |
| `status` | `string` | One live line: "Ravi is 2.1 km away". |
| `meta` | `string` | Right-aligned line: order number, item count. |

### TrackStep

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` |  |
| `time` | `string` | "9:12 am", "Tue 14". Shown under the label. |
